title: The Rust one-field core property setters take a character XML cannot carry, and the next save fails
symptom: Rust set_title, set_author, set_subject and set_keywords return nothing and accept a C0 control character (other than tab, line feed and carriage return), U+FFFE or U+FFFF; every later save then fails with the package writer's error, which names the part and the character ("/docProps/core.xml holds U+0007 at line 3, column 15, a character XML 1.0 cannot carry"). Rust set_core_properties, set_application_properties and set_custom_property, Python and the CLI refuse such a value at once, naming the property, and leave the document unchanged. A character XML 1.0 cannot carry that the file already holds in a core, application or custom property (written as a character reference by another producer) is dropped from that value when the properties are changed, since the part is written again from them
workaround: Rust: set the value through set_core_properties, which refuses it, or set it again without the character before saving
